description: Run a shell command from a thread's composer and hand the agent the command and its output in one message. Use it when the agent's sandbox or permission mode blocks a command that needs your secrets or access: the agent proposes it, you run it, and the agent only sees the output. Send with Mod+Alt+Enter or Send menu → Run in terminal; the command runs once in the thread's own environment, on whichever machine the session uses, local or remote. You can also highlight a command in an agent's answer and pick Run in terminal next to Add to chat. Fenced shell code blocks in an answer also get a one-click Run in terminal button; python blocks get it once you turn on the runPythonBlocks setting. The message waits in the queue while the command runs, then reaches the agent as a sh block and an output block, so its next answer starts from the real result. Recognizable input prompts open the command's existing Terminal tab for you to answer. Option/Alt-click a Run button or use Run in thread shell to reuse variables and the working folder in one persistent shell per thread. Commands that outlast the wait (30 seconds by default) keep running in the thread's Terminal panel, and pagers are off so git log and git diff print in full. Messages from agents, other plugins and bb thread tell never run a command; commands run with your account's full rights, outside the agent's permission mode. Requires bb 0.49+ and a POSIX shell (macOS or Linux; Windows is not supported).
